messages:
maria: heads-up — saffron (tenant saffron-prod-01) is seeing 5xxs and T/S SLO violations on dedicated cluster 'cedar' since ~03:12 UTC. customer reports a big marketing spike. they see 503s and timeouts. can infra triage? :exclamation:

ajay: on it. can you paste a sample request id or a quick repro curl so I can grep logs? what hosts/pool is cedar mapped to?

maria: repro curl below (customer token redacted). reproduces a 503 within 2-3s in our test: 

```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \ 
  -H "X-Request-ID: saffron-req-20260307-01" \ 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"hello"}'
```

Admission log snippet from cedar (03:12:07 UTC):
```
[admission] time=2026-03-07T03:12:07Z tenant=saffron-prod-01 action=reject reason=burst_credits_exhausted tps=1280 limit_tps=1000 headroom=0.00
[admission] time=2026-03-07T03:12:15Z tenant=saffron-prod-01 action=reject reason=burst_credits_exhausted tps=1355 limit_tps=1000 headroom=0.00
[admission] time=2026-03-07T03:12:45Z tenant=saffron-prod-01 action=admit variant=gpt-small-quantized tokens=34
```

maria: note customer also reported increased p50/p95 latency spikes for allowed requests.

dana: @ops-bot can you dump autoscale and GPU utilization for cedar 02:50-03:20? suspect noisy neighbor or mis-sized headroom. :eyes:

ops-bot: autoscale events for cluster cedar:
- 2026-03-07T02:50:00Z scaledDown replicas 12 -> 8 (policy: off-peak)
- 2026-03-07T03:05:12Z scaledUp replicas 8 -> 12 (policy: reactive-burst, delay=18s)
- burst_credits: saffron-prod-01 consumed 100% of burst pool at 03:12:10Z; shard=cedar-us-east-1-a
GPU utilization snapshot (03:10 UTC): cedar-node-17 nvidia=98% occupancy, cedar-node-18 nvidia=92%

kevin: looks like noisy neighbor. one tenant (quantumops-prod) had long inference batches around 03:00-03:08 — their jobs show continuous kernel occupancy and large KV cache residency. recommend isolating with QoS or pinning saffron to dedicated pool.

kevin: quick check cmds we ran: 
```
# top pod GPU usage
kubectl -n inference top pod | grep nvidia
# kernel traces
kubectl logs -n infra cedar-node-17 --since=30m | grep "kernel_ms"
```

ajay: immediate mitigation options:
- grant temporary burst credits to saffron (admin:increase-burst --tenant saffron-prod-01 --amount 300k)
- route saffron -> fallback model variant with lower token cost (gpt-small-quantized) via rollout policy for next 15m
- increase min_replicas for cedar pool to add headroom (min_replicas: +4)

maria: customer ok with any short-term fix. they prefer not to throttle user experience.

dana: longer term: tune autoscale cooldowns and predictive prewarm for marketing-like traffic patterns. also add per-tenant GPU QoS caps and better noisy-neighbor detection (track sustained kernel occupancy >85% for >60s).

ajay: reproduction plan for infra to validate admission behaviour: run synthetic traffic at 1200 tps with token sizes matching saffron (avg 45 tokens) against cedar and watch admission/logs. sample script: 
```
# simulate tps
for i in $(seq 1 1200); do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST" -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"x"}' &
  sleep 0.001
done
```

kevin: note: don't run on prod without throttling control; use a staging shard or cordon nodes.

maria: assigning tasks — ajay to add temp burst credits + trigger fallback route, dana to open a noisy-neighbor bug and propose QoS change, kevin to prepare repro on staging and share monitoring dashboards. I'll update customer ETA. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: created incident INC-2026-03107-cedar-burst, assigned to ajay, dana, kevin. link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-03107-cedar-burst

maria: thanks team — I'll post a short postmortem with root cause once we confirm. :white_check_mark:
